services.desc: The Rockwell Museum features a year-round calendar of unique events and programs, for all ages and interests, with art at its core. We use art to connect and engage with people of all ages and interests. From concerts and parties to lectures by leading scholars and arts education, our programs are recognized for being innovative, thought-provoking, fun and inspiring!
